changelog: 🎨 Phase 21: UI Modernization & Streaming File Attachments (Ported from Antigem v1.1.6).
⚡ Streaming File Uploads: Zero-memory-pressure file streaming with live upload progress indicators and 'From Files' direct attachment.
🖼️ Smart Image Shrinker: Automatic downscaling of large photos before upload to conserve mobile bandwidth and LLM token budgets.
📱 Edge-to-Edge Experience: Fully transparent system status bars and dynamic animated splash prism with custom smooth interpolators.
🎬 Integrated Video Player: Fullscreen video host and overlay controls for media playback directly inside chats and files.
